resources.string: Start ShamHost on the host phone, run "shamhost url" there and copy the address.
No ShamHost server found on this network.
Check both devices are on the same network and the service is running (shamhost status).
Termux is not installed on this device. This screen only works on the host phone.
Add this line to ~/.termux/termux.properties inside Termux and restart it:\nallow-external-apps = true
Could not send the command. Check allow-external-apps = true
Command copied — paste it into Termux
Termux is not installed. Get it from F-Droid (not Google Play), then come back.
ShamHost seems not installed or not running on this device. Tap "Install ShamHost" to do everything automatically inside Termux, or "Start services" if it is already installed.
Install started in Termux — wait for the password, then come back and tap Connect.
To stop Android killing the server, allow unrestricted battery use.
On launch the app requests: notifications, file access, and running commands in Termux. Android has no single "grant all" switch, so each permission gets its own dialog.
